title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: discover sensitive data shared to cloud apps and websites via the network layer
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the government-cloud roadmap plan from Microsoft's documentation of existing network indicators. Licensing, prerequisites, content-capture qualifications and timing are supported; the collection-policy route and the explanation of its general-purpose PowerShell command need minor clarification.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 501539 plans IRM discovery of sensitive files and text shared to any cloud application or website, including generative AI, via the network layer.
claims.quote: With this update, Insider Risk Management will support the discovery of sensitive files and text shared to any cloud application or website (inc. GenAI) via network layer.

claims.fix: Keep the path, which correctly reaches policy creation. Add to controls[1].note: 'The wizard then configures conditions, activities, data sources and user scope, content capture, Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers, and Turn on.' These later choices are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/collection-policies-create-deploy-policy.

claims.claim: New-FeatureConfiguration -FeatureScenario KnowYourData -ScenarioConfig <JSON string> creates collection policies in general, with the note explicitly leaving network-specific expression unconfirmed.
claims.quote: KnowYourData for collection policies ... The ScenarioConfig parameter specifies additional information about the feature configuration. ... Includes UploadText and DownloadText activity for all supported classifiers. Captures all AI prompts.
claims.fix: Clarify controls[1].note as: 'Public Preview, available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell and not in all organizations. ScenarioConfig configures collection-policy activities and content capture; reference examples use Activities and IsIngestionEnabled, but do not document the network enforcement-plane value.' Keep the call as general collection-policy automation, not a verified network-specific configuration.
